How Connected Planning Works

One flow keeps your plan, tracking, and analysis connected.

1PlanAdd income and allocate your paycheck.
2TrackRecord income and expenses as they happen.
3ReviewBudget vs. Actual updates from your tracked activity.
4AnalyzeUse your debt, mortgage, savings, and subscription views to look ahead.
▤

Guides & Help

Find answers and learn at your own pace.

“A little setup today, a smoother tomorrow.”
QUICK START

Set up your PLAN

Use one simple flow. Enter the plan once, track what happens, then review the results.

1PlanOpen Budget by Paycheck. Add your income first, then add fixed costs, debt, savings, and sinking funds.
2AllocateSelect each paycheck and confirm how much of each category belongs to it. A Previous Check Preview is locked and does not count toward the current month.
3TrackUse Income & Expense Tracker for what actually happened. The tracker feeds Budget vs. Actual.
4Review & AnalyzeUse Overview for the monthly snapshot, Yearly Overview for the bigger picture, and the analysis pages for mortgage, debt, savings, and subscriptions.
One source of truthMake budget decisions in Budget by Paycheck. Use Yearly Overview and the analysis pages to review the same plan instead of rebuilding it in multiple places.
